anchors.anchor_seat: driver H-point (vehicle-left/+X seat, US LHD), child of tractor; face +Z

facing: +Z (cab front toward +Z); total length ~22.0 m, trailer box 16.15 x 2.6 x 2.85 m (top at 4.10 m)
sides: L/R are the vehicle's own left/right: L = +X, R = -X
hierarchy: walmart_truck > tractor > {steer_FL > wheel_FL, steer_FR > wheel_FR, wheel_RL1/RR1/RL2/RR2, trailer > {landing_gear, trailer_wheel_*, trailer_door_L/R}}

rig.drive: move/rotate the tractor node (or root) on the ground; tractor origin = ground point under the fifth wheel = centre of the rear tandem (bicycle-model rear axle)
rig.steer: rotate steer_FL/steer_FR about local Y (+ = turn toward +X/vehicle left), typical max +-35 deg; Ackermann: inner wheel more
rig.spin: rotate wheel_* about local X; angle = distance / 0.52 m (tyre radius)
rig.articulate: rotate trailer about local Y (its origin is exactly on the kingpin at the fifth-wheel plate top)
rig.landing_gear: translate landing_gear +Y by 0..0.25 m to retract the legs (pads off the ground)

nodes.tractor: origin on the ground directly under the kingpin/fifth wheel (= rear tandem centre); drive node
nodes.trailer: child of tractor; origin EXACTLY at the kingpin on the fifth-wheel plate top (y=1.22 m, 4.15 m behind the front of the overall origin): rotate about Y to articulate
nodes.landing_gear: child of trailer; inner legs + sand pads; origin on the ground between the pads; translate +Y to raise
nodes.steer_FL/steer_FR: children of tractor; Empty on the steering kingpin axis (x=+-0.90, at axle height 0.52 m), rotate about local Y to steer
nodes.wheel_FL/FR: children of steer_FL/FR; origin exactly at the hub/axle centre, spin about local X
nodes.wheel_RL1/RR1/RL2/RR2: tractor rear dual wheels, children of tractor, origin at axle centre, spin about local X
nodes.trailer_wheel_L1/R1/L2/R2: trailer dual wheels, children of trailer, spin about local X
nodes.trailer_door_L/R: children of trailer, origin on the outer hinge line at door bottom: rotate about Y to swing open (L: negative angle opens outward, R: positive)
